verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a real-time streaming and stage platform, so letting phone callers join by SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out is a fair question for it. The evidence covers participation only through the broadcast SDKs, guest spots and audio rooms, and never mentions SIP, PSTN or phone dial-in/out. With no documented telephony bridging, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out
